prova:
use 1
  constructor
  · norm_num
  · intro n
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ sumInvPrimesNotDvdCentralBinom n := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro p hp
      split_ifs <;> positivity
    by_cases h : sumInvPrimesNotDvdCentralBinom n ≤ 1
    · exact h
    · push_neg at h
      exact False.elim (by linarith)
